source_revision: The commit containing this evidence directory

minio.build: go install github.com/minio/minio@v0.0.0-20250907161309-07c3a429bfed; built locally from pinned official source, not a release binary

environment.proxy_scope: HTTP_PROXY/HTTPS_PROXY/ALL_PROXY removed case-insensitively from the command subprocess environment only; global configuration unchanged

scope: Single-domain signed CreateSubtask with explicit root consent, live parent lease/epoch/version, immutable recipient-policy intersection, original subject and separate recipient actor, four-dimensional H-to-D/child B transfer, receipt replay and atomic rollback. Actual RPC-created child paths exercised at admission and mock-target send; nested delegation and zero allocations verified. Operator provisions recipient policies and command issuer signs envelopes. Child-budget closeout/return, cancellation propagation, complete contract validation, GW/SDK subtask ingress, recipient-policy management, token exchange and cross-domain execution remain pending. Repeated benchmark is root control paths only, not delegation latency or production capacity.
development_note: Initial full correctness run passed 36 gates. Read-through then corrected delegated grant revocation, user-facing delegation consent disclosure, and rechecks after insert/FK/trigger waits. A UI test compile-time return-value mismatch was fixed before the targeted run; targeted subtask, executor and consent tests passed. Final frozen sources first failed solely at TestIdentityDaemonProcess TempDir cleanup: Windows sharing violation on instancekey.exe, with no business assertion failure. That failed run and cluster shutdown log are retained. No instancekey.exe process was observed afterward; a native CreateFileW DELETE-access probe subsequently succeeded without deleting the file (winerror 0). The same frozen sources were rerun on a new isolated cluster; all 39 gates passed. No failed business assertion was retried or suppressed; benchmark ran only in the successful final gate sequence.
